notes: The dative לְ is unrepresented and its suffix takes the bare English indirect object 'her', which is rule 40's own תְּנָה לִּי → 'give me'.
'let ... praise' is the jussive's volitive frame under rule 17, headed on the lexical verb and discontinuous around the subject phrase under rule 25.
The partitive מִן takes 'of' and the construct פְּרִי a supplied 'the' under rule 29, no article morpheme standing in the chain.
